subject: biology
promptStrong: Give me a 6-mark exam-style question on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a worked example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: The optimum temperature for most human enzymes is about:
questions.explain: Most human enzymes work best at around body temperature, 37°C.

questions.q: What is the word equation for aerobic respiration?
questions.explain: Aerobic respiration uses glucose and oxygen to release energy, producing carbon dioxide and water.

questions.q: A root hair cell has a long projection. How does this help its function?
options: It helps the cell carry oxygen
It allows the cell to photosynthesise
It increases surface area for absorbing water and minerals
questions.explain: The long extension gives a large surface area for absorbing water and mineral ions.

questions.q: What are the products of anaerobic respiration in yeast?
questions.explain: In yeast, anaerobic respiration (fermentation) produces ethanol and carbon dioxide.

questions.q: A nerve cell (neurone) is long and has many branched connections. This adaptation allows it to:
options: Carry electrical impulses over long distances and connect to many cells
questions.explain: The length and branches let neurones transmit impulses across the body and link to many other cells.

questions.q: Why does a very high or very low pH usually stop an enzyme working?
options: It changes the shape of the active site, denaturing the enzyme
It turns the enzyme into a product
It gives the enzyme more energy
questions.explain: Extreme pH alters the active site's shape (denaturation) so the substrate no longer fits.

questions.q: Which of these is a limiting factor for photosynthesis?
questions.explain: Light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration and temperature can all limit the rate of photosynthesis.

questions.q: An image of a cell is 30 mm long and the magnification is ×1500. What is the actual size?
questions.explain: Actual = image ÷ magnification = 30 mm ÷ 1500 = 0.02 mm = 20 µm.

questions.q: What is the word equation for photosynthesis?
questions.explain: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water with light energy to make glucose and oxygen.

questions.q: What is the main reason living cells need to respire?
options: To release energy for life processes
questions.explain: Respiration releases energy needed for processes such as movement, growth and keeping warm.

questions.q: Which pigment absorbs light energy for photosynthesis?
questions.explain: Chlorophyll in the chloroplasts absorbs light energy for photosynthesis.

questions.q: What is the function of ribosomes?
questions.explain: Ribosomes are the site of protein synthesis.
